headline_marked: State Minister [[Ishraque Ahmed resigns]] after gun-in-hand drug drive
headline: State Minister Ishraque Ahmed resigns after gun-in-hand drug drive
summary: The minister resigned to avoid embarrassing his party following a controversial drug raid where he was seen holding a firearm.
details: State Minister Ishraque Ahmed has resigned from his post following a controversial drug drive where he was seen holding a gun in his hand.
The resignation letter has been received by the Cabinet Division, and a formal notification is expected to be issued shortly.
Ishraque stated that he is resigning on his own accord to ensure that his party is not embarrassed by the controversy.
During a press conference at the National Press Club, he defended his actions, maintaining that the fight against drugs must continue.
He clarified that while the party may not have wanted the specific manner of the operation, he is stepping down to maintain political decorum.
caption:
A State Minister resigns after being seen with a gun during a drug raid. He says he's doing it to save his party from embarrassment.

State Minister Ishraque Ahmed has resigned from his post following a controversial drug drive where he was seen holding a gun in his hand.

The resignation letter has been received by the Cabinet Division, and a formal notification is expected to be issued shortly.

Ishraque stated that he is resigning on his own accord to ensure that his party is not embarrassed by the controversy.

During a press conference at the National Press Club, he defended his actions, maintaining that the fight against drugs must continue.

He clarified that while the party may not have wanted the specific manner of the operation, he is stepping down to maintain political decorum.

headline_marked: Diamond World MD [[Dilip Agarwala arrested]] in money laundering case
headline: Diamond World MD Dilip Agarwala arrested in money laundering case
summary: The Dhaka Metropolitan Police's Detective Branch arrested the business leader in Banani on the request of the CID.
details: Diamond World Managing Director Dilip Kumar Agarwala was arrested by the Dhaka Metropolitan Police's Detective Branch (DB) in Banani this evening.
DMP Deputy Commissioner (Media) Md Aktar Hossain confirmed the arrest to the media.
According to DB sources, the arrest was made at the request of the Criminal Investigation Department (CID) in connection with a money laundering case filed against him.
This is not the first time Agarwala has been detained. On September 3, 2024, he was detained by the Rapid Action Battalion (RAB).
He was previously arrested in a case involving the killing of teenager Hridoy Ahmed in Dhaka's Badda during the July Uprising, but was later released on bail.
